main_text.p: etiam singulos vicos disjungunt. Estque in unoquoque territorio certus tribunalis locus. Ac quoniam in territoriis singulis prædia hujusmodi complura sunt, accidit ferè, ut per vices & successiones annuas prædiorum domini jurisdictionem cum imperio habeant, idque secundum modum aut numerum prædiorum, quæ possident. Nam qui prædium hujusmodi unum tantum tenet, unius tantum anni jurisdictionem in eodem territorio habet; qui duo, duobus; qui plura, pluribus: & si quis omnia, perpetuam quoque juris dicundi potestatem eo in tribunali obtinet: idemque valet in iis, qui jus illud prædiis cohærens à præsdiorum dominis prædia ipsa retinentibus, quamquam id veteri instituto plane contrarium sit, pecuniâ, pactione, dono, cessione, denique quoquo modo sibi acquisiverunt. Quâ ratione Dammonense tribunal, quod olim multorum fuit, nunc ad solos Ripperdæos & Houverdæos, aut eos, qui his successêre, Farmsumanum verò vicorumq; aliquot vicinorum ad unos etiam ac solos Ripperdæos devolutum videmus.

page.notes: Printed text is a single unbroken paragraph running over from the previous page (first line starts without indent). Doubtful readings: "præsdiorum" in the line "cohærens à præ-" was set as printed; the word after "à" should read "prædiorum" and is marked here as a likely printing slip; "successêre" was read with a circumflex and could be "successêre" or similar, not fully certain. The line with "Quâ ratione" has a visible gap in the scan; "Farmsumanum" and "Dammonense" are as printed. The ligature forms æ in "præ-" and "Ripperdæos" are read from the scan and should be checked. Digitiser's watermark at lower right is excluded.
